stories.text: A failed diagnostic cannot mislead me or discard my changes.
The venue measures the exact leg list declared by the candidate.
I can distinguish pre-existing compiler defects from model-change regressions and verify both are fixed.
Cancellation verification proves cleanup and absence of credential writes without turning unrelated machine scheduling into an undeclared product latency requirement.
I can verify that attaching a watch to a large already-committed region drains its equally large filter output without confusing fixture scheduling with a process-watch regression.
I can distinguish resource-admission defects from children that finish before the fixture establishes overlapping ownership, and verify every terminal path returns permits.
